value.signature: fn frame_integer (& mut self , amount : GrossAmount) -> Result < Computed , NumericError >

review.body: { let result = (| | { let radix = Rational :: from_ratio (256 , 1 , & mut self . budget) ? ; let mut value = Rational :: zero () ; for byte in amount . bytes () { value = value . mul (& radix , & mut self . budget) ? ; let digit = Rational :: from_ratio (i64 :: from (* byte) , 1 , & mut self . budget) ? ; value = value . add (& digit , & mut self . budget) ? ; } Ok (Computed { exact : Exact :: new (value , & mut self . budget) ? , }) }) () ; if result . is_err () { super :: refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: Only opaque public Actor names, gross amount bytes, frame entries, explicit allowances and the caller-owned exact budget enter. Full tracing retains their Debug representations, results and typed failures; no secret, publication codec, chain recognition, identity binding or subscriber enters the body.
